description: A table's PUBLIC page — the address its owner gives to people who have no account. Answers every switch of the page with its meaning, what a visitor can do there right now in plain words, what a visitor GETS (visitor_gets: the columns sent to them and the hidden ones, what the search takes, the «nothing found» words, the address that opens ONE record), and the addresses to hand out: the page's link, short link and embed code, and the same three for the public FORM that adds a record. Call it when the person asks for a link to share, a link to one record, an embed code for their site, or whether their data is open.

report_id.description: A report of that table (from get_reports): the public page of the REPORT — its own switches, columns and search. Leave it out for the table's own page

name: get_public_page
